kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتحاسب (form VI)
# نَتَحَاسَبُ (nataḥāsabu) /na.ta.ħaː.sa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَاسَبَ (taḥāsaba)
# نَتَحَاسَبَ (nataḥāsaba) /na.ta.ħaː.sa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَاسَبَ (taḥāsaba)
# نَتَحَاسَبْ (nataḥāsab) /na.ta.ħaː.sab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَاسَبَ (taḥāsaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
